finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production transparent sprite atlas for Dream Town. Cozy polished hand-painted isometric 3D game art, warm oak, cream plaster, terracotta, jewel green foliage, lighting upper left. EXACT 4 columns and 2 rows, 8 isolated sprites, row-major ordering. Sprite animation sheet, TWO characters in separate rows, four poses each. Top row SAME friendly stocky guard in silver helmet, royal blue surcoat with gold trim, round blue shield with gold emblem, short wooden spear, facing RIGHT: ready stance; controlled forward spear thrust; shield blocking; return to ready. Bottom row SAME short bandit in dark olive hood, brown clothes, red face scarf, leather boots, small wooden club, facing LEFT: ready stance; club lunge; recoil from block; stepping backward retreat. Consistent costume, head size, body proportions and camera between frames; ground feet on same baseline in each row, equal framing and sprite scale. No plinths, scenery, sparks, blood, injury or text. Lighthearted stage duel, non-graphic. Single character per cell, weapons stay entirely inside its cell. CRITICAL keep every sprite SMALL, centered in central 55% of each equally sized cell, huge fully transparent gutters on all sides, no touching or cropping. Truly transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no captions, no lettering, no labels, no grids. Same orthographic 3/4 isometric camera for world objects; front view for UI. Crisp readable silhouettes.
